A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right corner of the game-text box, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 20 January 2015. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-blizzard2-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Blizzard 2 (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The wording differs from the 2013 slip: “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition &lt; 4. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2. Landspeed may not be increased.” (printed text with “Landspeed may not be increased.” added at the end). This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title. There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits at the lower right corner of the game-text box.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
